company: The Kenific Group, Inc. (dba Pantheon Data)
dod_intent_evidence: Genuine DoD motion (Navy SBIR, USCG/DoD/DHS program support per own site) but the company is explicitly a professional-services/IT-consulting firm: 'Pantheon Data delivers powerful professional services solutions to federal and commercial clients—from IT and cybersecurity to engineering and consulting' with '30+ Programs supported across the DoD and DHS' and '100% of all USCG Major Acquisition Programs supported' as staffing/consulting metrics.
what_they_do: Government IT/cybersecurity/engineering/logistics consultancy (rebranded The Kenific Group to Pantheon Data) that staffs and supports 30+ DoD/DHS/USCG programs — a services shop, not a product company.
